title: Sharp Broken-Power Lorentz Estimates for Fractional Powers of Radial Schrödinger Operators with Inverse-Square Asymptotics
summary: Let $H=-Δ+V(|x|)$ be a nonnegative radial Schrödinger operator on $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\ge 2$, whose positive harmonic function satisfies $U(r)\simeq r^{-σ_0}$ for $0<r\le 1$ and $U(r)\simeq r^{-σ_\infty}$ for $r\ge 1$, with $-d/2<σ_0,σ_\infty<d/2$. Assuming the two-sided ground-state heat-kernel estimate of Ishige, Kabeya, and Ouhabaz, we determine the maximal open range in which the kernel of $H^{-s/2}$ admits the clean two-sided estimate $K_s^H(x,y)\simeq |x-y|^{s-d}U(|x|)U(|y|)/[U(|x|+|x-y|)U(|y|+|x-y|)]$, namely $0<s<\min\{d,d-2σ_0,d-2σ_\infty\}$.
